description: Get recent news articles about a company from Brave Search and NewsAPI. Returns article titles, descriptions, sources, and publication dates sorted by recency. Use company name, not domain. Coverage depends on server-side API key configuration.

company_name.description: Company name as it would appear in news articles (e.g. 'Anthropic', 'OpenAI', 'Tesla'). Do not pass a domain.

name: get_company_news
